name: looot: work email waterfall with verification

parameters.content:
## Work email waterfall
POST {first_name, last_name, domain} to the webhook.
looot tries up to 3 email finders for the same job, then checks the address.
Cap: $0.05 per lookup. A miss or a failed call costs $0.
Credential: Header Auth named "looot API", Authorization = Bearer <your looot token>.
